title: Staging Deploy

request.justification: Deploying new service version to staging for integration testing

expected.explanation: No matching allow in Role Matrix for role "Developer", action "ec2:RunInstances", resource type "ec2", environment "staging"

teachingPoint: Not all EC2 actions are the same — Developer role allows Describe/Start/Stop but not RunInstances (provisioning)

title: PassRole Trap

request.justification: Need to pass roles to Lambda functions for faster deployment workflow

expected.explanation: No matching allow in Role Matrix for role "Developer", action "iam:PassRole", resource type "iam", environment "dev"

teachingPoint: iam:PassRole is a high-risk hinge permission — wildcard resource PassRole can enable privilege escalation

title: Intern Describes Instances

request.justification: Learning about the infrastructure setup for onboarding documentation

expected.explanation: Intern role has explicit allow for ec2:DescribeInstances in dev environment

teachingPoint: Read-only describe actions in dev are safe and appropriate for learning — this is least privilege in action

title: Developer RDS Snapshot

request.justification: Creating a snapshot before deploying database migration to staging

expected.explanation: Developer role permits rds:CreateDBSnapshot in staging environment

teachingPoint: Developers can perform write operations in non-prod environments — staging snapshots before migrations are good practice

title: Security Reviews IAM Policies

request.justification: Reviewing IAM policies for overly permissive access patterns

expected.explanation: Security Engineer role permits IAM read actions in all environments

teachingPoint: Security Engineers need IAM read access to audit policies — this is core to their job function

title: Developer Stops Dev Instance

request.justification: Stopping dev instance to save costs over the weekend

expected.explanation: Developer role permits ec2:StopInstances in dev environment

teachingPoint: Cost-conscious instance management in dev is encouraged — developers can start and stop their own instances

title: Intern Invokes Lambda

request.justification: Testing the hello-world Lambda as part of onboarding tutorial

expected.explanation: Intern role does not include Lambda permissions — only S3 read, EC2 describe, and RDS describe in dev

teachingPoint: Interns have a very narrow permission set — Lambda invoke is a Developer-level action

title: Analyst Reads Staging Export

request.justification: Downloading staging analytics export to validate data pipeline

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role permits s3:GetObject in all environments with confidential classification

teachingPoint: Data Analysts have S3 read access everywhere — their role is built around data consumption

title: Developer Uploads to Dev

request.justification: Uploading test fixtures for unit test suite

expected.explanation: Developer role permits s3:PutObject in dev with internal classification

teachingPoint: Dev environment is the developer's playground — write access to your own team's buckets is standard

title: Auditor Checks Dev Compliance

request.justification: Verifying that dev environment also meets encryption compliance rules

expected.explanation: Auditor role permits AWS Config read actions in all environments

teachingPoint: Compliance doesn't stop at prod — auditors verify controls across all environments
